subject: PO onboarding & vendor-setup: NorthRidge next steps and checklist
body:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Price <anna.price@northridge.com>, Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@northridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO onboarding & vendor-setup: NorthRidge next steps and checklist

Hi Anna / Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. To keep momentum, can we confirm the procurement details so we can issue a PO and get your team onto Dedicated? Below are the items Redwood needs to complete vendor setup and PR/PO issuance. Please review and reply with any missing pieces by EOD Wednesday (08/18).

Required items from NorthRidge for vendor setup and PO issuance:
- Company legal name & W9 (or W8 if non-US) — signed PDF preferred
- Preferred billing contact + email and billing address
- Vendor tax ID / VAT registration number
- Standard invoicing cadence (monthly / net30 / net45) and PO reference requirements
- Bank remit instructions (ACH/ wire) — redacted example OK for security
- Any special line-item requirements (project codes, cost centers, SOW reference)

Redwood PO specifics we need to confirm:
- PO line-item structure: we prefer one line per sku/metric (e.g., Dedicated Hours - vCPU/GPU hours; Model License - model id/version; Support - monthly SLA tier). See attached PO-LineItem-Structure-v1.csv for example format.
- Billing breakouts: include token-based overage lines and monthly committed capacity line items
- Approval path: indicate if PO will auto-route to your AP or require a signer on first invoice

Timeline (target):
- 08/18: NorthRidge returns vendor form + W9 + billing details
- 08/20: Redwood issues draft PO and routing for signatures
- 08/25: PO fully executed and first invoice date agreed

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Form.pdf (fillable), PO-LineItem-Structure-v1.csv, Mutual-Action-Plan_NR-Redwood.docx

If you'd prefer, I can send the vendor form as a DocuSign powerform (linked below) to capture signatures quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this set up.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Partnerships & Procurement
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

---

From: Anna Price <anna.price@northridge.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@northridge.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding & vendor-setup: NorthRidge next steps and checklist

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers inline below and a couple of follow-ups.

- Legal name & W9: attached (NorthRidge Analytics, Inc. - W9.pdf)
- Billing contact: Beth Harper, beth.harper@northridge.com, 1234 Market St, Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Invoicing cadence: Net 30; PO number required on invoice header
- Bank remit: ACH preferred — will send a redacted sample in separate secure email

Line-item question: Do you need us to include project codes on each invoice line or is a single header-level PO field sufficient? Our billing system is easier if project codes are per line.

Also, we requested a standard SOW template from Legal this morning — should have it by Tuesday.

Best,
Anna
VP Finance, NorthRidge Analytics
anna.price@northridge.com

---

On Tue, 17 Aug 2026 at 12:18 PM PDT, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Anna Price <anna.price@northridge.com>
Cc: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@northridge.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding & vendor-setup: NorthRidge next steps and checklist

Anna — thanks for the quick reply and for the W9. Answering your project-code question: Redwood's AP prefers project codes at the line-item level for capacity/usage allocations; that maps cleanly to our billing exports. If NorthRidge can do per-line project codes, that would be ideal. If it's a blocker we can accept a header field but will need a short mapping file each billing period.

Next steps (updated):
- Please send redacted bank remit via secure channel (we'll provide a SFTP upload link)
- Legal SOW when available; if your SOW references specific deliverables, we will add them as line items (e.g., committed GPU hours, support SLA)
- We will produce a draft PO by 08/20 to route for signatures. Marissa — can you confirm Redwood's preferred PO structure and the approver list so we can route correctly?

Thanks,
Lauren

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Price <anna.price@northridge.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO onboarding & vendor-setup: NorthRidge next steps and checklist

Looping in final PO guidance — we should follow the CSV template attached but note these mandatory fields for AP: PO_Number, Line_Number, Description, Quantity, Unit_Price, Extended_Amount, Project_Code (if provided), Invoice_Reference, Tax_Indicator.

A few clarifications for NorthRidge:
- Redwood requires one committed-capacity line item (monthly) and one usage/overage line (per-1000 tokens or per-GPU-hour) when applicable.
- For first invoices include the executed PO number and reference the signed MSA/SOW filename.
- If NorthRidge cannot provide per-line project codes, include a mapping CSV each month with invoice upload.

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: PO-LineItem-Structure-v1.csv, Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Form.pdf
